security_tag.description: The security tag used for the AppArmor profile ($SECURITY_TAG). Mandatory.

command.description: The primary command to execute within the confined environment.

use_classic.description: If true, requests classic confinement via --classic flag.

base_snap.description: The base snap to use as the root filesystem, passed via --base.

enable_debug.description: If true, enables SNAP_CONFINE_DEBUG to print diagnostics to stderr.
